This thread is for posting locations only, not for asking where it is or general chitchat.

FAQ:
> Dig isn't working.
Make sure your game is updated and you're on the Pizza 1 server.
> Still isn't working...
Cloudsave your game, you may be stuck on the previous day.
> Is there a new dig yet?
You can check for yourself. Cloudsave and try typing dig. If it says to come back tomorrow, that means no.
